items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (J.C. Higginbotham) does not speak in the provided transcript. The mention of Bessie Smith is made by the Interviewer and another speaker (Mrs. H), with no personal connection or interaction described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Do you remember of any attraction, the name of any band of people who used to come to the Eighty-One and Ninety-One?
At that time. One of the Smiths - was it Bessie Smith or Bessie Brown?
Was Bessie Smith through there, or Mamie Smith?
